Dates are DD/MM/YYYY here (13/03/2026 = 13 March 2026). IMPORTANT for the backtest: 'Ace 79k is what am i looking at.. atm' carries an author but NO timestamp of its own (it renders as a reply-quote between the 23:38 and 23:56 messages), so it is recorded in claims but deliberately NOT in statements. CONTEXT SHIFT worth flagging: the attached chart shows BTC last at 72,107.4 (+1,625.0, +2.31%), i.e. BELOW the 79k he was 'waiting for' on 15 Feb (IMG_7800) and 9 March (IMG_7799) - so by 13 March the 79k downside target appears already reached, and 79k is now being referenced as an UPSIDE level from ~72.1k. Direction recorded 'long' on that basis plus the bullish retrospective ('we not going lower than 66k'), but this image alone does not state a side or leverage for the open positions. The position-panel figures are heavily garbled: the column headers (NET VALUE / COLLATERAL / ENTRY PRICE / MARK PRICE / LIQUIDATION PRICE) cannot be reliably matched to the OCR'd numbers, so entry/pnl/size are left null rather than guessed. The many chart price labels (89,027.3 / 85,126.6 / 74,617.4 ...) look like drawn horizontal levels or resting orders; which are levels vs axis ticks is not recoverable from text. '07:52' is likely a chart timestamp or phone clock.
